bms_g_4168_20000000.name: bms_meas_request_flag
bms_g_4168_20000000.description: One-byte request flag read by bms_4168_08007a0c. That function passes its value as the last argument of bms_meas_interp_filter_dispatch and clears it to 0 right after the call, so it acts as a one-shot request for the measurement update (who sets it is not visible in this packet). Ghidra also recorded 4-byte accesses at this address, and the address-taken reports from bms_startup_init_unpack and other routines are probably matches of the RAM base constant 0x20000000 rather than uses of this byte; neither was verified.

bms_g_4168_2000068c.name: bms_reset_cause_sw
bms_g_4168_2000068c.description: Latched reset-cause flag for a software reset. bms_vtor_reset_cause_latch sets it to 1 at boot when bit 28 (SFTRSTF) of RCC_CSR at 0x40021060 is set; bms_fault_class_get tests it first and returns class 1 when it is set. The analysed code only ever writes 1, so it stays set until RAM is re-initialised, and whether startup clears it is not established.

bms_g_4168_2000068d.name: bms_reset_cause_iwdg
bms_g_4168_2000068d.description: Latched reset-cause flag for an independent-watchdog reset. bms_vtor_reset_cause_latch sets it to 1 at boot when bit 29 (IWDGRSTF) of RCC_CSR at 0x40021060 is set. bms_fault_class_get returns class 2 when it is set and the software-reset flag at 0x2000068C is clear. Only written to 1 in the analysed code, so it stays set until RAM is re-initialised.

bms_g_4168_2000068e.name: bms_reset_cause_pin
bms_g_4168_2000068e.description: Latched reset-cause flag for an NRST pin reset. bms_vtor_reset_cause_latch sets it to 1 at boot when bit 26 (PINRSTF) of RCC_CSR at 0x40021060 is set. bms_fault_class_get returns class 3 when it is set and the two flags before it at 0x2000068C and 0x2000068D are clear. Only written to 1 in the analysed code, so it stays set until RAM is re-initialised.
